segments.name: campus bookstores
products: new, used, rental and digital textbooks
segments.description: Operates physical and virtual bookstores for college and university campuses, selling course materials, books, emblematic apparel, supplies and general merchandise to students and faculty.
segments.evidence: The Company currently operates as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Students and campus institutions pay for course materials, textbooks and general merchandise, with institutions billed directly for the First Day affordable access programs.
revenueModel.evidence: students are billed the below market rate directly by the institution as a course charge or included in tuition.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2025 the company realigned its operating and reporting segments around a centralized management structure supporting company-wide procurement, marketing and selling, delivery, and customer service.
changes.evidence: During fiscal year 2025, management realigned the Company's operating and reporting segments to better reflect a centralized management structure supporting company-wide procurement, marketing and selling, delivery, and customer service.
